## [1.14.1](https://github.com/Alastor-Kaneki/Morphe-Patches/compare/v1.14.0...v1.14.1) (2026-08-24)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **mcpe-center:** make package rename fingerprint order-independent ([02bc171](https://github.com/Alastor-Kaneki/Morphe-Patches/commit/02bc171c95718f07b043eccab385157446dd2738))
* **release:** accept spaced Gradle version property ([b81f280](https://github.com/Alastor-Kaneki/Morphe-Patches/commit/b81f280d7818755496ea9fb06cc8dea174301817))
* **release:** auto-update latest bundle metadata ([8277193](https://github.com/Alastor-Kaneki/Morphe-Patches/commit/8277193070025e922367de605cfe7e958bf7d43e))

patches.name: MonkeyScript userscript manager
patches.description: Adds a Chrome 150 Material You userscript manager using a Violentmonkey-derived parser, native app-menu integration, guaranteed Fork-page installation, Greasy Fork/Sleazy Fork support, publishing, and configurable app/package cloning.

patches.name: Download GX mods as files
patches.description: Adds a visible Download Mod button in Opera GX, with URL auto-detection and a Share fallback.

patches.name: GX icon pack
patches.description: Adds a separate native selector for all 56 Opera GX launcher icons. Open it from the GX Icon Pack long-press shortcut.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Hard-disables Pixilart native/Cordova ads, drawing-editor web ads, and promoted/feed ad cards.

patches.name: Customize Suno branding
patches.description: Clones Suno to a different package name, with optional app-name and launcher-icon customization. Accepts Morphe's adaptive custom-icon folder layout or a simple icon.png folder.

options.description: Optional replacement name shown by Android for the patched Suno app.
Android package ID for the patched Suno clone. It must differ from com.suno.android.

Optional folder containing the launcher icon.

Easy layout:
- icon.png

Morphe adaptive layout:
- mipmap-mdpi/morphe_adaptive_background_custom.png
- mipmap-mdpi/morphe_adaptive_foreground_custom.png
- mipmap-hdpi/morphe_adaptive_background_custom.png
- mipmap-hdpi/morphe_adaptive_foreground_custom.png
- mipmap-xhdpi/morphe_adaptive_background_custom.png
- mipmap-xhdpi/morphe_adaptive_foreground_custom.png
- mipmap-xxhdpi/morphe_adaptive_background_custom.png
- mipmap-xxhdpi/morphe_adaptive_foreground_custom.png
- mipmap-xxxhdpi/morphe_adaptive_background_custom.png
- mipmap-xxxhdpi/morphe_adaptive_foreground_custom.png

You may provide only the density folders you need, but each provided density
must contain both the background and foreground image.

patches.name: Download timestamped lyrics
patches.description: Adds an in-app Lyrics button and share target that exports Suno timing data as LRC, enhanced LRC, SRT, WebVTT, or JSON.

patches.name: Custom download folder
patches.description: Adds a native Android folder picker, a Download folder app shortcut and automatic saving of downloaded add-ons to the selected folder.

patches.name: Preserve premium entitlement
patches.description: Keeps an already-observed premium entitlement stable across local preference migrations without granting premium to a fresh install.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Disables app-open, banner, native, interstitial and rewarded ad loading while keeping the app UI flow intact.

patches.name: Rename package
patches.description: Changes the Android package ID and updates the app-specific provider/permission references used for Minecraft imports.

options.description: Android package ID for the patched app.
